title: Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.28368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Games are a robust test for large language model agents: they require sequential decisions, adversarial or cooperative interaction, state tracking, reasoning under uncertainty, and long-horizon planning. However, a one-time game benchmark can go stale as models, prompts, environment implementations, and evaluation policies change, and refreshing it is costly: full round-robin evaluation scales poorly in the number of model pairs, and the resulting outcomes live on incompatible per-game scales. We present a framework for continuous evaluation of LLM agents in game settings, organized around three coupled components. First, an adaptive scheduler that maps pairwise Bradley-Terry uncertainty to reduced per-pair match targets, concentrating budget on comparisons that remain unresolved. Second, a Unified Leaderboard (ULB) that reduces heterogeneous outcomes to pairwise evidence and fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model by minorization-maxim

translated_title: 调度、排名、画像：游戏中大语言模型智能体的持续评估
translated_abstract: 游戏是大语言模型智能体的一项稳健测试：它们需要序贯决策、对抗性或合作性交互、状态跟踪、不确定性下的推理以及长时程规划。然而，一次性的游戏基准测试会随着模型、提示词、环境实现和评估策略的变化而过时，而刷新它的代价高昂：全循环评估在模型对数量增加时扩展性差，且产生的结果存在于互不兼容的各游戏尺度上。我们提出了一个在游戏环境中持续评估大语言模型智能体的框架，该框架由三个相互耦合的组件构成。首先，是一个自适应调度器，它将成对的Bradley-Terry不确定性映射为缩减的每对比赛目标，把预算集中于仍未解决的比较上。其次，是一个统一排行榜（ULB），它将异构的评估结果归约为成对证据，并通过Minorization-Maximization方法拟合一个游戏平衡的Bradley-Terry模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向游戏中大语言模型智能体的持续评估框架，通过自适应调度器根据Bradley-Terry不确定性分配比赛预算，并利用统一排行榜拟合游戏平衡的Bradley-Terry模型，从而实现跨游戏、可持续更新的智能体能力排名。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a continuous evaluation framework for LLM agents in games, featuring an adaptive scheduler that allocates match budgets based on Bradley-Terry uncertainty and a Unified Leaderboard that fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model to enable sustainable, cross-game comparable agent rankings.
